label: copy phase, final two outputs (strongest on r/x/o/3 inputs)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L). It never fires on original-phase or <DEL> steps, and never on step L+1. Within the copy phase it is concentrated in the last few outputs: to_go=0 holds 47% of activation mass, to_go=1 31%, to_go=2 12%, and nothing at to_go>=6. The firing rate within this window is low (about 12-24%), and the input token modulates both rate and magnitude: r (rate 25%), x, o and 3 are strongly enriched, and these four tokens make up the top-quartile activations. The top activations are all L=3 sequences at t=4 with the fed-back token r or 3 (e.g. c r o <DEL> c [r]). Rate also varies non-monotonically with L and t (L=5 is low, L=3 is high), and no simple variable captures this. Restricting to the r/x/o/3/p/y input tokens raises dev F1 only to about 0.45, so the predicate is a coarse positional description with low precision.
